P.name: Z-Drive Resonance
P.description: {{sbc|Innate - Resonance:}} '''Ekko's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and damaging {{tip|abilities}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Resonance'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack consumes them all to deal {{pp|30 to 70 by 10; 80 + (140-80)/12*(x-1) for 15|color=magic damage}} {{as|(+ 80% AP)}} {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}. ''Z-Drive Resonance'' deals 270% damage against {{tip|monsters}}.
P.description2: ''Resonance'' cannot affect the same target more than once every few seconds.
P.description3: {{sbc|Innate - Stolen Time:}} Triggering ''Resonance'' against a {{tip|champion}} grants '''Ekko''' {{pp|key=%|50 to 80 for 4|1 to 16|color=movement speed}} {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for {{pp|2 to 3 for 3|1 to 11}} seconds.

Q.name: Timewinder
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' throws a temporal grenade in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
Q.description2: At 700 units or upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, the grenade slows down for {{fd|1.75}} seconds to gradually expand into a ''Temporal Sickness'' field that {{tip|slows}} nearby enemies, travelling for another 190 units.
Q.description3: Afterwards, the grenade contracts and homes back to '''Ekko''' at an increased speed, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
Q.leveling3: {{st|Return Magic Damage|{{ap|40 to 140}} {{as|(+ 70% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|80+40 to 140+140}} {{as|(+ {{ap|30+70}}% AP)}}}}
Q.description4: ''Enemies can be hit only once per pass.''

W.name: Parallel Convergence
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Ekko's''' basic attacks deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} equal to {{as|3% {{as|(+ 3% per 100 AP)}} of the target's '''missing''' health|health}} against enemies below {{sti|health|{{as|30% of their '''maximum''' health}}}}. The damage has a minimum threshold of 15 and is capped at 150 against {{tip|minions}} and {{tip|monsters}}.
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' creates an afterimage of himself that, after 2 seconds, bats a device to the target location and grants {{tip|sight}} of the area for {{fd|2.5}} seconds. After travelling over {{fd|1.25}} seconds, the device expands into a chronosphere that lasts for {{fd|1.5}} seconds and which {{tip|slow|slows}} enemies within by 40%.
W.description3: If '''Ekko''' enters the sphere before it expires, it detonates to grant him a {{tip|shield}} for 2 seconds and {{tip|stun}} enemies within for {{fd|2.25}} seconds.
W.description4: ''Enemies can see the indicator for Parallel Convergence 2 seconds after casting.''

E.name: Phase Dive
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction, then empowers his next basic attack within 3 seconds to have a {{fd|0.25}}-second cast time, gain {{sti|range|300 '''bonus''' range}}, cause him to {{tip|blink}} within {{tt|125|Estimated}} range of the target, and deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}.
E.description2: ''Phase Dive {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Ekko's''' basic attack timer. '''Ekko''' can cast any of his abilities during the dash.''

R.name: Chronobreak
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Upon learning ''Chronobreak'' or if its '''current''' cooldown is lower than 4 seconds, '''Ekko''' reveals a time-delayed ''afterimage'' of himself that constantly tracks where he was 4 seconds ago.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Ekko''' enters {{tip|stasis (buff)|stasis}} at the start of the cast time, and afterwards {{tip|heals}} himself, increased by {{as|{{pp|label1=health lost|key=%|key1=%|type=health lost in the last 4 seconds|0 to 300 for 11|0 to 100|formula=3% per 1% of health lost in the last 4 seconds}}|health}}, and {{tip|dash|dashes}} to his ''afterimage's'' location at the time of cast over {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Upon arrival, the stasis ends and he creates an explosion that deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies.
R.leveling2: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|200 to 500}} {{as|(+ 175% AP)}}}}{{st|Minimum Heal|{{ap|100 to 200}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}}|Maximum Heal|{{ap|400 to 800}} {{as|(+ 240% AP)}}}}
R.description3: '''''Ekko''' is immune to all {{tip|airborne|displacements}} during Chronobreak.''
